definition: {"fields": [{"name": "title", "type": "TEXT", "required": true, "label": "标题"}, {"name": "quantity", "type": "NUMBER", "label": "数量"}, {"name": "unit_price", "type": "NUMBER", "label": "单价"}, {"name": "discount", "type": "NUMBER", "label": "折扣"}, {"name": "start_date", "type": "DATE", "label": "开始日期"}, {"name": "end_date", "type": "DATE", "label": "结束日期"}, {"name": "total2", "type": "FORMULA", "expression": "ROUND(${quantity} * ${unit_price} - ${discount}, 2)", "label": "折后合计"}, {"name": "span_days", "type": "FORMULA", "expression": "DAYS(${end_date}, ${start_date})", "label": "间隔天数"}]}
